notes: «كتب نجدة بن عامر إلى ابن عباس» : نجدة is the asker in the scene; the answer is Ibn Abbas's words, and rule 5's asker link applies to a report's opening only, so نجدة is not a link here
«فشهدت ابن عباس»: Yazid witnessed Ibn Abbas's reply, so the shared tail (written once after the last ح) ends both routes at ابن عباس
